inanes.m: More than one inane. inane: extremely silly or stupid.

inapparently.m: In a way that is not apparent or obvious.

inappetences.m: More than one inappetence. inappetence: a lack of appetite.

inappetency.m: Another spelling of inappetence. inappetence: a lack of appetite.

inarch.m: To graft by uniting, as a scion, to a stock, without separating either from its root before the union is complete.

inarched.m: Past tense of inarch. inarch: to graft by uniting, as a scion, to a stock, without separating either from its root before the union is complete.

inarches.m: A form of inarch, as in “she inarches”. inarch: to graft by uniting, as a scion, to a stock, without separating either from its root before the union is complete.

inarching.m: An instance of grafting by union.

inarticulates.m: More than one inarticulate. inarticulate: without or deprived of the use of speech or words.

inaugurator.m: A form of inaugurate. inaugurate: commence officially.

inauthenticities.m: More than one inauthenticity. inauthenticity: the state of being inauthentic.
